title: The Do's and Don'ts of Error Handling • Joe Armstrong • GOTO 2018
summary: Joe Armstrong, inventor of Erlang, gives a GOTO Chicago 2018 talk on building fault-tolerant systems. He covers what to do and avoid when handling errors, arguing for letting processes fail and recover.
why: Recommended as a conceptual rather than code-heavy talk on failure recovery from Erlang's creator.

quote.text: it's well worth listening to this talk, which is conceptual and not code-centric
